Overview

Gibcom started in 2016 because local firms kept asking me for help with websites and search. It became a registered company in January 2019 and now serves over 500 customers from the Colmore Building in Birmingham, covering websites, search, Google Business Profile, conversion work, and more recently AI systems and cybersecurity for small and medium businesses.

The problem

Small businesses in the West Midlands were paying national agencies for work they did not understand and could not measure, or doing nothing and losing customers to competitors who showed up first on Google.

Approach

  • Plain-English service model: every recommendation comes with the reason it matters.
  • Local first: Birmingham as the credibility anchor, with case work across the West Midlands.
  • A weekly client update routine so customers always know what was done and why.
  • Security added as a service line once the credentials were in place, because the same clients were being phished.

What it looks like

Tools

  • SEO
  • Google Business Profile
  • Conversion rate optimisation
  • Google Merchant Center
  • WordPress
  • AI automation

Outcomes

  • Over 500 customers served
  • Team built and managed, including an apprentice
  • Credentials: ISO 27001, CISMP, CompTIA Security+, Google Professional Cybersecurity Certificate

What I learned

Being findable is the whole game for a local business. The second lesson came later: the same businesses that cannot afford a marketing agency also cannot afford a breach, and nobody was speaking to them about either in words they could use.
